title: IntakeBase
description: Canonical definitions library for intake schemas across audit-style skills. Captures the universal axes (document_type, verification_tier, flag_threshold, sources_available) and the citedPaper handoff shape. Skill-level intake schemas extend these with their own check-set enums and required-when rules. Uses Draft-07 'definitions' keyword (not '$defs') to match the project convention established by audit_report.json.

tierEnum.description: Verification depth. 1 = existence checks only; 2 = + alignment; 3 = full audit; custom = user-specified check set.

flagThresholdEnum.description: How aggressively to surface findings. conservative = high-confidence only; standard = default; strict = include INFORMATIONAL-tier hits.

domainEnum.description: Domain hint for tool selection. biomedical → PubMed/PMC default; general → Crossref/OpenAlex default; mixed → both tiers active.

sourcesAvailableEnum.description: What evidence the user provided. Drives whether alignment-style stages can run.

citedPaper.description: Pointer to artifacts emitted by an upstream summarizer (e.g., research-paper-summarizer's fork-return summary_paths). Lets a downstream audit consume canonical numerical/identifier records for a cited source instead of re-extracting from full text. Skill-level intake schemas reference this as an array (commonly named cited_papers[]).

paper_id.description: Stable identifier shared by stats.json (top-level paper_id) and source_meta.json (top-level paper_id). Join key for evidence pinning. Note: stats.json claims have claim_id, not paper_id — paper_id lives at the file root.
